sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा भरतः त्रस्तः भ्रातुः चारित्र शन्कया ।स्वस्य वम्शस्य माहात्म्यात् प्रष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे ॥२-७२-४३॥
transliteration: tat śrutvā bharataḥ trastaḥ bhrātuḥ cāritra śankayā ।svasya vamśasya māhātmyāt praṣṭum samupacakrame ॥2-72-43॥

translations.english: Conscious of the glory of his race, Bharata continued to enquire if there was any unrighteous conduct on the part of his brother.
